glosses.6a3ec39f54fd1001: los que están a vuestro cargo

notes.3a45b072ad23f661: STEPBible glosses κομισάμενοι "being repaid"; in Heb 11:13 the verb means "receive" (the promises), so the gloss renders that sense.
notes.5a250cb30007ecff: The English says "they", but the morphology is 3rd singular (neuter plural subject); the morphology is followed.
notes.b832074044e11bc5: Aramaic word transliterated (κοῦμι), kept as a transliteration.
notes.10ad3ef24adf2a48: Rom 3:4: the infinitive is passive (κρίνεσθαί σε, "when you are judged"); the English "judging" is rendered as the passive the morphology gives.
notes.466176684449dcbf: Luke 19:42: the Greek verb is singular (neuter plural subject, "the things for peace"); the plural follows the English and the subject.
notes.65b6ff58903ea161: "Superior" is the same word in Spanish and Portuguese.
notes.53d21998190e8fbb: "Superior" is the same word in Spanish and Portuguese.
notes.1d3c0aa10da13103: 1Cor 14:18: the English "speaking" renders an indicative 1st singular (λαλῶ); the morphology is followed.
notes.7fd852e369e4f579: Heb 2:3: the infinitive is passive (λαλεῖσθαι, "to be spoken"), referring to the salvation; rendered as the passive.
notes.2c2868edb8c42f91: John 8:40: the verb is 1st singular ("I have spoken", Jesus of himself); the English "has" follows "a man who"; the morphology is followed.
notes.eca8c00918d377a7: Aramaic word transliterated (λαμά), kept as a transliteration.
notes.7ef289d83bffbf44: 2Pet 2:22: a place where a pig rolls in the mud.
notes.4216fed860e154d3: Matt 15:36 (a textual variant): the morphology is indicative ("took"), not a participle; the morphology is followed.
notes.b6fc0a86874d726e: The English says "Were", but the morphology is 3rd singular (John was saying); the morphology is followed.
notes.ccdb3a6e4f0b689e: The English says "was", but the morphology is 3rd plural (the Pharisees); the morphology is followed.
notes.ce7d9579466cdfe9: Matt 11:17 (a textual variant): the morphology is indicative ("they say"); the morphology is followed.
notes.6a4bc759771dc7ff: Rom 11:4: the verb is present active ("says"); the English "spoken" goes with "what [was]"; rendered as the verb itself.
notes.2eba5c0e442eea58: Transliteration of λεπτά (small coins), kept as in the English.
notes.526c11f379c849b6: Transliteration of λεπτόν (a small coin), kept as in the English.

uncertain.7ef289d83bffbf44: "Revolcadero" para κύλισμα (hápax, 2 Pe 2:22; también se lee κυλισμός).
uncertain.b240a3e30bed71f1: 1 Ts 4:4: si "poseer/dominar su vaso" se refiere al propio cuerpo o a la esposa (o "adquirir") es discutido; "controlar" sigue al inglés.
uncertain.7135025e99140ff3: κυβέρνησις, hápax (1 Co 12:28): el sentido del don ("dirección", "administración", "gobierno") es discutido.
